_comment: Cases whose verdict or solver work measurably depends on the runner, per suite. A change of one of these, in outcome or in work, is reported and never alerts, in both the baseline and the previous-night comparison. Add a case only with the measurement that shows it changes on identical code; remove it once it is stable.

differential.BIOMD0000000338|klu_vs_dense: PASS (KLU against dense 1.1e-04 of the peak) on run 40521487203 (b543f7b9, AMD EPYC 9V45), EXCEPTION (CV_CONV_FAILURE at t=0.72) on 40586213480 (90e1293e, Intel Xeon 8370C), DIFF 3.5e-02 on an Apple M1 Max, the same to the digit at 5eb02398 and d1b27d5d. XIIa = K = CA = 0 at t=0 is an exact, unstable equilibrium of the model: KLU keeps it (XIIa stays 0), and the dense LU's rounding seeds the XIIa spike, in bngsim and in libRoadRunner alike, so the dense reference depends on the CPU. With XIIa(0) seeded at 1e-30, 1e-20 or 1e-12 the two solvers give the same trajectory.
